description: P-G3 switch (GA-PG3 = P-47, D-070). Off (default since GX-27, after the train merged a real batch): a head behind by at most merge.max_behind_base passes without a merge of the base, because the train re-proves the batch on the tip. On (the earlier rule, one-key rollback): a tier-1 head behind its base must carry a merge commit of the base (commit_check.rebase_errors). Merge commits only, never a rebase, either way (FP1).
